newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: US says more needed for China WTO entry.
newsitem.headline: US says more needed for China WTO entry.

text.p: A senior U.S. official said on Friday much more progress was needed before agreement could be reached on China's admission to the World Trade Organisation (WTO).
U.S. Assistant Deputy Trade Representative Robert B.Cassidy was speaking at the end of the latest round of discussions between current WTO members and a Chinese delegation.
"I think we've made some progress, but a lot more needs to be done," Cassidy told reporters.
He said Washington, whose stance Chinese officials make clear they see as the main obstacle to entry to the global trade body, was looking for a "more comprehensive offer" from Beijing.

This would include a final version of China's market access proposals for reducing tariffs on outside goods and on phasing out non-tariff barriers like quotas and a full offer on access for foreign service providers.
Once those elements were on the table, Cassidy said: "We could perhaps make even more progress."

China's assistant international trade minister, Long Yongtu, told reporters Beijing was working "very, very hard" on the services package which would be submitted to the WTO by the end of this month or early September.
"Until we see that offer, it's impossible to evaluate really where we are," said Cassidy.
His assessment was shared by a Japanese official. "A lot depends on the services offer, but we have been told not to expect too much," said the official.
He said the Chinese entry process, now running into its second decade, "is going very slowly at the moment.... I have the impression we are just entering the real negotiations."
WTO officials said the next meeting of the working party drafting China's entry terms would be held in October, but no date has yet been set.

Diplomats say they expect Beijing to come up with some major advance at that meeting to prepare for Chinese President Jiang Zemin's visit to Washington for talks with President Bill Clinton at the end of the month.
